item.title: Arkansas State Library Board releases state funds, creating new regulations for future
item.description: After weeks of putting state aid funds on pause for Arkansas libraries, the Arkansas State Library Board voted to release those funds at a special meeting on Monday afternoon.

item.title: Over 30,000 in Pulaski County head to polls for early voting
item.description: Just a day until the election, early voting has wrapped up, and Pulaski County says over 30,000 voters turned out to the polls before the big day.

item.title: Early voting underway in Arkansas for the March 3 primary & election
item.description: Arkansans can early vote from Feb. 17 through March 2 for the March 3 election, which includes a preferential primary and a special election for House District 70 and Senate District 26.

item.title: Maumelle High School evacuates after receiving bomb threat
item.description: Students and staff at Maumelle High School have evacuated after authorities said the school received a bomb threat Monday.
